name: Conan Exiles
tagline: Native connector inside the Conan Exiles dedicated server (Linux or Windows): no sidecar, no RCON, no mod.
requirements: Linux: control of the server start command (LD_PRELOAD)

assets.label: Linux server
assets.requires: Conan Exiles Linux dedicated server build 25792439 (or 25738716, 25639945)
assets.hint: Load libtakaro-conan-native.so with LD_PRELOAD and copy takaro.json and ca-certificates.crt to ConanSandbox/Saved/Config/Takaro/; INSTALL.md in the zip has every step.

assets.label: Windows server
assets.requires: Conan Exiles Windows dedicated server build 25792439 (or 25738716, 25639945)
assets.hint: Copy winmm.dll next to ConanSandboxServer-Win64-Shipping.exe and takaro.json to ConanSandbox\Saved\Config\Takaro\; INSTALL.md in the zip has every step.
